tests: Large organisation, small established internal tool: flat proven demand, not scaled or a high-volume workload. Entra ID is external; MFA, access group, append-only audit, retention and UK residency are mandatory despite low traffic. A real speed complaint has no number: performance.targets stays empty with a material unknown. Wider rollout is an unapproved trap.
